title: Human Psychology & Behaviour
tagline: Master Your Mind Before The World Masters You
summary: An exploration into the mechanics of human cognition, decision architecture, and mental sovereignty by Abinash Kumar.

keyThemes.themeDescription: Recognizing mental traps, confirmation biases, and social conditioning before they dictate your life path.
